/**
 * 공토코드를 조회한다.
 * 
 * @date 2018.01.24
 * @memberOf 이병현
 * @param {Array<String>} 공통코드
 * @param {Array<String> || Array<Array<String>>} 공통코드에 연결할 selectbox id || 공통코드에 연결 할 GridView ColumnID ["grd_gridVew", "col1"]
 * @param {String} callback function
 * @param {String} 공통코드에 설정 할 default Value Key Array
 * @returns {Object} dataList 객체
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * common._getCommonCodeSubmission(_comCdArr, _sbxIdArr, _callback, _defaultKeyArr);
 */
common._getCommonCodeSubmission = function(_comCdArr, _sbxIdArr, _callback, _defaultKeyArr){
	try {
		
		var comCdCnt = _comCdArr.length;
		var tmpDataObj  = [];
		var ListNmObj = [];

		//search 생성
		var searchColumnInfo = [ 
			 {"id" :"searchText", "name": "searchText", "dataType" :"text"},
			 {"id" :"targetId", "name": "targetId", "dataType" :"text"}
		];
		common.cfnCreateDataList("gds_comCdParam", "dataList", searchColumnInfo);
		
		for(var i=0; i<comCdCnt; i++){
			var _comCd 	= _comCdArr[i];
			var _sbxId 	= _sbxIdArr[i];
			var _sbxObj	= WebSquare.util.getComponentById(_sbxId);
						
			//List 생성
			var ListColumnInfo = [ 
				 {"id" :"cmnCd", "name": "cmnCd", "dataType" :"text"},
				 {"id" :"cmnCdDc", "name": "cmnCdDc", "dataType" :"text"},
				 {"id" :"cmnCdNm", "name": "cmnCdNm", "dataType" :"text"}
			];			
			
			var ListNm	= _sbxId+"_gds_cmmnCodeMList";
			if(typeof _sbxId !== "string"){
				ListNm	= _sbxId[0]+"_"+_sbxId[1]+"_gds_cmmnCodeMList";
			}
			common.cfnCreateDataList(ListNm, "dataList", ListColumnInfo);
			
			var targetId 			= "";
			var targetDefaultId 	= "";
			var targetGridID 		= "";
			var targetGridObj		= {};
			var targetColID			= "";
			//selectbox dataList bindding
			if(typeof _sbxId !== "string"){
				targetGridID 	= _sbxId[0];
				targetGridObj 	= WebSquare.util.getComponentById(targetGridID);
				targetColID		= _sbxId[1];
				targetGridObj.setColumnNodeSet(targetColID, 'data:'+ListNm,'cmnCdNm','cmnCd');
				targetId 			= _sbxId[0] + "_" +_sbxId[1];
				targetDefaultId 	= _sbxId[0]; 
			}else{
				var sbxObj	= WebSquare.util.getComponentById(_sbxId);
				sbxObj.setNodeSet('data:'+ListNm,'cmnCdNm','cmnCd');	
				targetId 		= _sbxId;
				targetDefaultId = _sbxId;
			}
			var comCdList 		= common.getComCd(_comCd);	
			if(comCdList != null){
				var dataListComp		= WebSquare.util.getComponentById(ListNm);
				var comSelectObj		= WebSquare.util.getComponentById(targetDefaultId);
				var comSelectObjName 	= comSelectObj.getPluginName();
				if((typeof comCdList !== "undefined") && (comCdList !== null) && (comCdList !== "")){
					dataListComp.setJSON(comCdList); 
					if(typeof _defaultKeyArr !== "undefined"){
						if(_defaultKeyArr[i] != null && _defaultKeyArr[i] != ""){
							 if(comSelectObjName == "gridView"){
								 comSelectObj.setColumnOption(targetColID, "defaultValue", _defaultKeyArr[i]); 
							}else{
								comSelectObj.setValue(_defaultKeyArr[i]);
							}
						}
					}
				}else{
					dataListComp.reform();
				}		
				common.setComCd(_comCd, comCdList);	
			}else{
				var tmpData 	= {"searchText":_comCd,"targetId":targetId}; 
				tmpDataObj.push(tmpData);
				ListNmObj.push(ListNm);
			}
		}		
		
		if(tmpDataObj.length > 0){
			gds_comCdParam.setJSON(tmpDataObj);
			var id 			= "cfnGetComCode";
			var action 		= "/ccd/selectGlobalCmmnCodeDList.do?callback="+ _callback;
			var ref 		= ["gds_comCdParam"];
			var target 		= ListNmObj;
			var callback 	= "common._getCommonCodeCallBack";
			ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target ,null ,callback);
		}else{		
			var fnCallback = window.scwin[_callback];
            if(typeof fnCallback === "undefined"){
            	fnCallback = eval(_callback);
            }
            
        	if (typeof fnCallback === "function") {
        		fnCallback();
        	}
		}
	} catch(e) { 
		console.log("[common._getCommonCodeSubmission] Exception :: " + e.message);
	} finally {
		mapColumnInfo = null;
		ListColumnInfo = null;
		ListNm = null;
		id = null;
		action = null;
		ref = null;
		target = null;
		callback = null;
	} 
};

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 *

 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";

 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**

var ajaxLib = {};

ajaxLib.CONTEXT_PATH = ""; // Context Path 경로
ajaxLib.SERVICE_URL = location.protocol + '//' + location.hostname + ':' + location.port;
ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MODE = "asynchronous"; // 기본 통신 모드 ( asynchronous / synchronous)
ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MEDIATYPE = "application/json"; // 기본 미디어 타입

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**
 * @type ajaxLib
 * @class ajaxLib
 */
var ajaxLib = {};

ajaxLib.CONTEXT_PATH = ""; // Context Path 경로
ajaxLib.SERVICE_URL = location.protocol + '//' + location.hostname + ':' + location.port;
ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MODE = "asynchronous"; // 기본 통신 모드 ( asynchronous / synchronous)
ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MEDIATYPE = "application/json"; // 기본 미디어 타입

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MEDIATYPE = "application/json"; // 기본 미디어 타입

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**

ajaxLib.DEFAULT_OPTIONS_MEDIATYPE = "application/json"; // 기본 미디어 타입

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *

 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

/**
 * 
 * 서비스(Submission)를 호출한다. //프로그래스바 기본처리(프로그래스바 안띄울 시 options.processMsg = false처리)
 * @date 2017.12.27
 * @memberOf ajaxLib
 * @param {String} id Submission Id
 * @param {String} action Service Action Url
 * @param {Array} refArr 서비스 호출 시 전달할 DataCollection Id 배열 및 옵션('M' : 'modified/수정된 CUD', 'I' : 'inserted', 'D' : 'deleted', 'U' : 'updated', 'A' : 'all', '' : 'all')
 * @param {Array} targetArr 서비스 응답 데이터를 저장할 DataCollection Id 배열
 * @param {Object} requestData 서비스 호출 시 전달할 JSON 객체
 * @param {String} callback function 명
 * @prarm {String or Object} String으로 처리 시 이동 Object로 처리 시 callback처리
 * @prarm {Object} option
 * @example
 * // Example-1
 * var id = "fnSearch";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-2
 * var id = "fnSearch2";
 * var action = "/rba/selectPaginatedUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_param1", "ds_param2"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target);
 * 
 * // Example-3
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref);
 *
 * // Example-4(Custom Call Callback function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack);
 * 
 * Example-5(Error callback Function)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var errorCallBack = "scwin.errorHandler";
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, errorCallBack); 
 *	scwin.errorHandler = function(resBody, e, id){
 *		
 *	};
 * 
 * // Example-6(옵션 및 프로그래스 바 안나오도록 옵션 처리)
 * var id = "fnSave";
 * var action = "/rba/saveUserList.do";
 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

 * var ref = ["ds_userList:M"];
 * var target = ["ds_userList"];
 * var callBack = "scwin.test";
 * var options = {		//프로그래스바 안나오도록 옵션처리
 *		processMsg : false
 *	};
 * ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, ref, target, null, callBack, null, options);
 */
ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

		'' : 'all'

			return flagObj[_flag];
		}

	var targetStr = "";

				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {

			}
		}

			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",

		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);

ajaxLib.callSubmission = function(id, action, refArr, targetArr, requestData, callBack, errorCallback, option) {
	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

	var flagObj = {
		'M' : 'modified', 
		'I' : 'inserted',
		'D' : 'deleted',
		'U' : 'updated',
		'A' : 'all',
		'' : 'all'
	};

	var getStt = function(_flag) {
		if (_flag == null || typeof _flag == 'undefined' || $.trim(_flag) == '') {
			return 'all';
		} else {
			return flagObj[_flag];
		}
		return;
	};

	var refStr = "";
	var targetStr = "";
	var stt;
	
	
	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < refArr.length; i++) {
			
			if (refStr != "")
				refStr += ",";
			
			var str = refArr[i].split(':');
			if (str != null && str.length > 0) {
				stt = getStt(str[1]);
			}
			
			if (typeof stt == 'undefined') {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '" }';
			} else {
				refStr += "{" + '"id":"' + str[0] + '", "key" : "' + str[0] + '", "action" : "' + stt + '" }';
			}
		}
	}

	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "")) {
		for (var i = 0; i < targetArr.length; i++) {
			if (targetStr != "")
				targetStr += ",";
	
			targetStr += "{" + '"id":"' + targetArr[i] + '", "key" : "' + targetArr[i] + '" }';
			
		}
	}

	if ((typeof refArr !== "undefined") && (refArr !== null) && (refArr !== "") && (refArr.length > 0)) {
		refStr = "data:json, [" + refStr + "]";
	} else {
		refStr = "";
	}
	
	if ((typeof targetArr !== "undefined") && (targetArr !== null) && (targetArr !== "") && (targetArr.length > 0)) {
		targetStr = "data:json, [" + targetStr + "]";
	} else {
		targetStr = "";
	}
	
	var _calBack 		= callBack || null;
	var _errorCallback  = errorCallback || null;
	var dOption = {
			id : id,
			action : action,
			ref : refStr,
			target : targetStr,
			processMsg : "",
			submitDoneHandler : callBack,
			submitErrorHandler : _errorCallback,
			submissionType : 0
	};
	var options = $.extend({}, dOption, option);
	
	var submissionObj = $w.getSubmission(options.id);
	if(options.submissionType == 0){
		ajaxLib._createSubmission(options);
	}else{
		ajaxLib._createSubmissionNoneReturn(options);
	}
	

	$w.executeSubmission(options.id, requestData);
}

	var submitHandler = options.submitHandler || "";
	var submitDoneHandler = options.submitDoneHandler || "fnCallback";
	var submitErrorHandler = options.submitErrorHandler || "";
	var isShowMeg = false;
	var resBody = null;

	if ((options.isProcessMsg === true) && (processMsg === "")) {
		processMsg = "해당 작업을 처리중입니다";
	}

	if (typeof options.isShowMeg !== "undefined") {
		isShowMeg = options.isShowMeg;
	}

	var submissionObj = {
		"id" : options.id,
		"ref" : ref,
		"target" : target,
		"action" : action,
		"method" : method,
		"mediatype" : mediatype,
		"encoding" : "UTF-8",
		"instance" : instance,
		"replace" : replace,
		"mode" : mode,
		"processMsg" : processMsg,
		"submitHandler" : function(e) {	},
		"submitDoneHandler" : function(e) {
            if (mediatype === "application/json") {
                if (typeof e.responseJSON !== "undefined") {
                    resBody = e.responseJSON;
                }else{
                	if (typeof e.responseText !== "undefined") {
                		try
                		{
	                		var resJSON 	= JSON.parse(e.responseText.replaceAll('\n', '\\n'));
	                		var errorCd		= resJSON.errorCode;
	                		var errorMsg	= resJSON.errorMessage;
	                		if(errorCd != null){
	                			if(errorMsg != null){
	                				alert(errorMsg);
	                			}
	                		}
	                		if(submitErrorHandler != null && submitErrorHandler != ""){
	            				if(typeof submitErrorHandler == "string"){
	            					if( -1 < submitErrorHandler.indexOf("/w2/itb/main.xml")){
	            						window.location.href="/";
	            					} else {
	            						common.changeTab(submitErrorHandler, null, null, null, 1);
	            					}
	                			}else{
	                				 var fnErrorCallback = window.scwin[submitErrorHandler];
	                				 if (typeof submitErrorHandler === "function") {

	                              	 }
	                				 
	                				 if(typeof fnErrorCallback === "undefined"){
	                                 	fnErrorCallback = eval(submitErrorHandler);
	                                 }
	                                 
	                             	if (typeof fnErrorCallback === "function") {

	                			}

	                		return;

                		catch(e)
                		{
                			//return common.gfnSessionCheck(action);
                		}
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (typeof e.responseText !== "undefined") {
                    resBody = e.responseText;
                }
            }
            
            fnCallback = window.scwin[submitDoneHandler];
            
            // 업무 CALLBACK 함수 오류 시 try catch
            try{
            	if(typeof fnCallback === "undefined"){
                	fnCallback = eval(submitDoneHandler);
                }
                
            	if (typeof fnCallback === "function") {
            		fnCallback(resBody, e, options.id);
            	}
            }catch(er){
            	WebSquare.logger.printLog("#################");
            	WebSquare.logger.printLog(er);
            	WebSquare.logger.printLog("#################");

        	if (typeof fnCallback === "function") {

	};

        return false;
      }());
      // if vertical mode always make maxSlides and minSlides equal
      if (slider.settings.mode === 'vertical') { slider.settings.maxSlides = slider.settings.minSlides; }
      // save original style data
      el.data('origStyle', el.attr('style'));
      el.children(slider.settings.slideSelector).each(function() {
        $(this).data('origStyle', $(this).attr('style'));
      });

      // perform all DOM / CSS modifications
      setup();
    };

    /**
     * Performs all DOM and CSS modifications
     */
    var setup = function() {
      var preloadSelector = slider.children.eq(slider.settings.startSlide); // set the default preload selector (visible)

      // wrap el in a wrapper
      el.wrap('<div class="' + slider.settings.wrapperClass + '"><div class="bx-viewport"></div></div>');
      // store a namespace reference to .bx-viewport
      slider.viewport = el.parent();

      // add aria-live if the setting is enabled and ticker mode is disabled
      if (slider.settings.ariaLive && !slider.settings.ticker) {
        slider.viewport.attr('aria-live', 'polite');
      }
      // add a loading div to display while images are loading
      slider.loader = $('<div class="bx-loading" />');
      slider.viewport.prepend(slider.loader);
      // set el to a massive width, to hold any needed slides
      // also strip any margin and padding from el
      el.css({
        width: slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal' ? (slider.children.length * 1000 + 215) + '%' : 'auto',
        position: 'relative'
      });
      // if using CSS, add the easing property
      if (slider.usingCSS && slider.settings.easing) {
        el.css('-' + slider.cssPrefix + '-transition-timing-function', slider.settings.easing);
      // if not using CSS and no easing value was supplied, use the default JS animation easing (swing)
      } else if (!slider.settings.easing) {
        slider.settings.easing = 'swing';
      }
      // make modifications to the viewport (.bx-viewport)
      slider.viewport.css({
        width: '100%',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        position: 'relative'
      });
      slider.viewport.parent().css({
        maxWidth: getViewportMaxWidth()
      });
      // apply css to all slider children
      slider.children.css({
        float: slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal' ? 'left' : 'none',
        listStyle: 'none',
        position: 'relative'
      });
      // apply the calculated width after the float is applied to prevent scrollbar interference
      slider.children.css('width', getSlideWidth());
      // if slideMargin is supplied, add the css
      if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal' && slider.settings.slideMargin > 0) { slider.children.css('marginRight', slider.settings.slideMargin); }
      if (slider.settings.mode === 'vertical' && slider.settings.slideMargin > 0) { slider.children.css('marginBottom', slider.settings.slideMargin); }
      // if "fade" mode, add positioning and z-index CSS
      if (slider.settings.mode === 'fade') {
        slider.children.css({
          position: 'absolute',
          zIndex: 0,
          display: 'none'
        });
        // prepare the z-index on the showing element
        slider.children.eq(slider.settings.startSlide).css({zIndex: slider.settings.slideZIndex, display: 'block'});
      }
      // create an element to contain all slider controls (pager, start / stop, etc)
      slider.controls.el = $('<div class="bx-controls" />');
      // if captions are requested, add them
      if (slider.settings.captions) { appendCaptions(); }
      // check if startSlide is last slide
      slider.active.last = slider.settings.startSlide === getPagerQty() - 1;
      // if video is true, set up the fitVids plugin
      if (slider.settings.video) { el.fitVids(); }
      if (slider.settings.preloadImages === 'all' || slider.settings.ticker) { preloadSelector = slider.children; }
      // only check for control addition if not in "ticker" mode
      if (!slider.settings.ticker) {
        // if controls are requested, add them
        if (slider.settings.controls) { appendControls(); }
        // if auto is true, and auto controls are requested, add them
        if (slider.settings.auto && slider.settings.autoControls) { appendControlsAuto(); }
        // if pager is requested, add it
        if (slider.settings.pager) { appendPager(); }
        // if any control option is requested, add the controls wrapper
        if (slider.settings.controls || slider.settings.autoControls || slider.settings.pager) { slider.viewport.after(slider.controls.el); }
      // if ticker mode, do not allow a pager
      } else {
        slider.settings.pager = false;
      }
      loadElements(preloadSelector, start);
    };

    var loadElements = function(selector, callback) {
      var total = selector.find('img:not([src=""]), iframe').length,
      count = 0;
      if (total === 0) {
        callback();
        return;
      }
      selector.find('img:not([src=""]), iframe').each(function() {
        $(this).one('load error', function() {
          if (++count === total) { callback(); }
        }).each(function() {
          if (this.complete) { $(this).trigger('load'); }
        });
      });
    };

        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Sets the el's animating property position (which in turn will sometimes animate el).
     * If using CSS, sets the transform property. If not using CSS, sets the top / left property.
     *
     * @param value (int)
     *  - the animating property's value
     *
     * @param type (string) 'slide', 'reset', 'ticker'
     *  - the type of instance for which the function is being
     *
     * @param duration (int)
     *  - the amount of time (in ms) the transition should occupy
     *
     * @param params (array) optional
     *  - an optional parameter containing any variables that need to be passed in
     */
    var setPositionProperty = function(value, type, duration, params) {
      var animateObj, propValue;
      // use CSS transform
      if (slider.usingCSS) {
        // determine the translate3d value
        propValue = slider.settings.mode === 'vertical' ? 'translate3d(0, ' + value + 'px, 0)' : 'translate3d(' + value + 'px, 0, 0)';
        // add the CSS transition-duration
        el.css('-' + slider.cssPrefix + '-transition-duration', duration / 1000 + 's');
        if (type === 'slide') {
          // set the property value
          el.css(slider.animProp, propValue);
          if (duration !== 0) {
            // bind a callback method - executes when CSS transition completes
            el.bind('transitionend webkitTransitionEnd oTransitionEnd MSTransitionEnd', function(e) {
              //make sure it's the correct one
              if (!$(e.target).is(el)) { return; }
              // unbind the callback
              el.unbind('transitionend webkitTransitionEnd oTransitionEnd MSTransitionEnd');
              updateAfterSlideTransition();
            });
          } else { //duration = 0
            updateAfterSlideTransition();
          }
        } else if (type === 'reset') {
          el.css(slider.animProp, propValue);
        } else if (type === 'ticker') {
          // make the transition use 'linear'
          el.css('-' + slider.cssPrefix + '-transition-timing-function', 'linear');
          el.css(slider.animProp, propValue);
          if (duration !== 0) {
            el.bind('transitionend webkitTransitionEnd oTransitionEnd MSTransitionEnd', function(e) {
              //make sure it's the correct one
              if (!$(e.target).is(el)) { return; }
              // unbind the callback
              el.unbind('transitionend webkitTransitionEnd oTransitionEnd MSTransitionEnd');
              // reset the position
              setPositionProperty(params.resetValue, 'reset', 0);
              // start the loop again
              tickerLoop();
            });
          } else { //duration = 0
            setPositionProperty(params.resetValue, 'reset', 0);
            tickerLoop();
          }
        }
      // use JS animate
      } else {
        animateObj = {};
        animateObj[slider.animProp] = value;
        if (type === 'slide') {
          el.animate(animateObj, duration, slider.settings.easing, function() {
            updateAfterSlideTransition();
          });
        } else if (type === 'reset') {
          el.css(slider.animProp, value);
        } else if (type === 'ticker') {
          el.animate(animateObj, duration, 'linear', function() {
            setPositionProperty(params.resetValue, 'reset', 0);
            // run the recursive loop after animation
            tickerLoop();
          });
        }
      }
    };

    /**

    var populatePager = function() {

          linkContent = i + 1;
          slider.pagerEl.addClass('bx-default-pager');

        // var linkContent = slider.settings.buildPager && $.isFunction(slider.settings.buildPager) ? slider.settings.buildPager(i) : i + 1;
        // add the markup to the string
        
        // ** a 태그 클릭 안되도록 함
        pagerHtml += '<div class="bx-pager-item"><a href="" data-slide-index="' + i + '" class="bx-pager-link">' + linkContent + '</a></div>';
        //pagerHtml += '<div class="bx-pager-item"><a href="" class="bx-pager-link">' + linkContent + '</a></div>';
      }
      // populate the pager element with pager links
      slider.pagerEl.html(pagerHtml);
    };

    };
