      slider.pagerEl.on('click touchend', 'a', clickPagerBind);
    };

    /**
     * Appends prev / next controls to the controls element
     */
    var appendControls = function() {
      slider.controls.next = $('<a class="bx-next" href="">' + slider.settings.nextText + '</a>');
      slider.controls.prev = $('<a class="bx-prev" href="">' + slider.settings.prevText + '</a>');
      // bind click actions to the controls
      slider.controls.next.bind('click touchend', clickNextBind);
      slider.controls.prev.bind('click touchend', clickPrevBind);
      // if nextSelector was supplied, populate it
      if (slider.settings.nextSelector) {
        $(slider.settings.nextSelector).append(slider.controls.next);
      }
      // if prevSelector was supplied, populate it
      if (slider.settings.prevSelector) {
        $(slider.settings.prevSelector).append(slider.controls.prev);
      }
      // if no custom selectors were supplied
      if (!slider.settings.nextSelector && !slider.settings.prevSelector) {
        // add the controls to the DOM
        slider.controls.directionEl = $('<div class="bx-controls-direction" />');
        // add the control elements to the directionEl
        slider.controls.directionEl.append(slider.controls.prev).append(slider.controls.next);
        // slider.viewport.append(slider.controls.directionEl);
        slider.controls.el.addClass('bx-has-controls-direction').append(slider.controls.directionEl);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Appends start / stop auto controls to the controls element
     */
    var appendControlsAuto = function() {
      slider.controls.start = $('<div class="bx-controls-auto-item"><a class="bx-start" href="">' + slider.settings.startText + '</a></div>');
      slider.controls.stop = $('<div class="bx-controls-auto-item"><a class="bx-stop" href="">' + slider.settings.stopText + '</a></div>');
      // add the controls to the DOM
      slider.controls.autoEl = $('<div class="bx-controls-auto" />');
      // bind click actions to the controls
      slider.controls.autoEl.on('click', '.bx-start', clickStartBind);
      slider.controls.autoEl.on('click', '.bx-stop', clickStopBind);
      // if autoControlsCombine, insert only the "start" control
      if (slider.settings.autoControlsCombine) {
        slider.controls.autoEl.append(slider.controls.start);
      // if autoControlsCombine is false, insert both controls
      } else {
        slider.controls.autoEl.append(slider.controls.start).append(slider.controls.stop);
      }
      // if auto controls selector was supplied, populate it with the controls
      if (slider.settings.autoControlsSelector) {
        $(slider.settings.autoControlsSelector).html(slider.controls.autoEl);
      // if auto controls selector was not supplied, add it after the wrapper
      } else {
        slider.controls.el.addClass('bx-has-controls-auto').append(slider.controls.autoEl);
      }
      // update the auto controls
      updateAutoControls(slider.settings.autoStart ? 'stop' : 'start');
    };

    /**
     * Click pager binding
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var clickPagerBind = function(e) {
      var pagerLink, pagerIndex;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (slider.controls.el.hasClass('disabled')) {
        return;
      }
      // if auto show is running, stop it
      if (slider.settings.auto  && slider.settings.stopAutoOnClick) { el.stopAuto(); }
      pagerLink = $(e.currentTarget);
      if (pagerLink.attr('data-slide-index') !== undefined) {
        pagerIndex = parseInt(pagerLink.attr('data-slide-index'));
        // if clicked pager link is not active, continue with the goToSlide call
        if (pagerIndex !== slider.active.index) { el.goToSlide(pagerIndex); }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Updates the pager links with an active class
     *
     * @param slideIndex (int)
     *  - index of slide to make active
     */
    var updatePagerActive = function(slideIndex) {
      // if "short" pager type
      var len = slider.children.length; // nb of children
      if (slider.settings.pagerType === 'short') {
        if (slider.settings.maxSlides > 1) {
          len = Math.ceil(slider.children.length / slider.settings.maxSlides);
        }
        slider.pagerEl.html((slideIndex + 1) + slider.settings.pagerShortSeparator + len);
        return;
      }
      // remove all pager active classes
      slider.pagerEl.find('a').removeClass('active');
      // apply the active class for all pagers
      slider.pagerEl.each(function(i, el) { $(el).find('a').eq(slideIndex).addClass('active'); });
    };

    /**
     * Performs needed actions after a slide transition
     */
    var updateAfterSlideTransition = function() {
      // if infinite loop is true
      if (slider.settings.infiniteLoop) {
        var position = '';
        // first slide
        if (slider.active.index === 0) {
          // set the new position
          position = slider.children.eq(0).position();
        // carousel, last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === getPagerQty() - 1 && slider.carousel) {
          position = slider.children.eq((getPagerQty() - 1) * getMoveBy()).position();
        // last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === slider.children.length - 1) {
          position = slider.children.eq(slider.children.length - 1).position();
        }
        if (position) {
          if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') { setPositionProperty(-position.left, 'reset', 0); }
          else if (slider.settings.mode === 'vertical') { setPositionProperty(-position.top, 'reset', 0); }
        }
      }
      // declare that the transition is complete
      slider.working = false;
      // onSlideAfter callback
      slider.settings.onSlideAfter.call(el, slider.children.eq(slider.active.index), slider.oldIndex, slider.active.index);
    };

    /**
     * Click pager binding
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var clickPagerBind = function(e) {
      var pagerLink, pagerIndex;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (slider.controls.el.hasClass('disabled')) {
        return;
      }
      // if auto show is running, stop it
      if (slider.settings.auto  && slider.settings.stopAutoOnClick) { el.stopAuto(); }
      pagerLink = $(e.currentTarget);
      if (pagerLink.attr('data-slide-index') !== undefined) {
        pagerIndex = parseInt(pagerLink.attr('data-slide-index'));
        // if clicked pager link is not active, continue with the goToSlide call
        if (pagerIndex !== slider.active.index) { el.goToSlide(pagerIndex); }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Updates the pager links with an active class
     *
     * @param slideIndex (int)
     *  - index of slide to make active
     */
    var updatePagerActive = function(slideIndex) {
      // if "short" pager type
      var len = slider.children.length; // nb of children
      if (slider.settings.pagerType === 'short') {
        if (slider.settings.maxSlides > 1) {
          len = Math.ceil(slider.children.length / slider.settings.maxSlides);
        }
        slider.pagerEl.html((slideIndex + 1) + slider.settings.pagerShortSeparator + len);
        return;
      }
      // remove all pager active classes
      slider.pagerEl.find('a').removeClass('active');
      // apply the active class for all pagers
      slider.pagerEl.each(function(i, el) { $(el).find('a').eq(slideIndex).addClass('active'); });
    };

    /**
     * Performs needed actions after a slide transition
     */
    var updateAfterSlideTransition = function() {
      // if infinite loop is true
      if (slider.settings.infiniteLoop) {
        var position = '';
        // first slide
        if (slider.active.index === 0) {
          // set the new position
          position = slider.children.eq(0).position();
        // carousel, last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === getPagerQty() - 1 && slider.carousel) {
          position = slider.children.eq((getPagerQty() - 1) * getMoveBy()).position();
        // last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === slider.children.length - 1) {
          position = slider.children.eq(slider.children.length - 1).position();
        }
        if (position) {
          if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') { setPositionProperty(-position.left, 'reset', 0); }
          else if (slider.settings.mode === 'vertical') { setPositionProperty(-position.top, 'reset', 0); }
        }
      }
      // declare that the transition is complete
      slider.working = false;
      // onSlideAfter callback
      slider.settings.onSlideAfter.call(el, slider.children.eq(slider.active.index), slider.oldIndex, slider.active.index);
    };

      }

      // if autoDelay was not supplied, start the auto show normally
      } else {
        el.startAuto();

        //add focus and blur events to ensure its running if timeout gets paused
        $(window).focus(function() {
          el.startAuto();
        }).blur(function() {
          el.stopAuto();
        });
      }
      // if autoHover is requested
      if (slider.settings.autoHover) {
        // on el hover
        el.hover(function() {
          // if the auto show is currently playing (has an active interval)
          if (slider.interval) {
            // stop the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.stopAuto(true);
            // create a new autoPaused value which will be used by the relative "mouseout" event
            slider.autoPaused = true;
          }
        }, function() {
          // if the autoPaused value was created be the prior "mouseover" event
          if (slider.autoPaused) {
            // start the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.startAuto(true);
            // reset the autoPaused value
            slider.autoPaused = null;
          }
        });
      }
    };

    /**
     * Performs needed actions after a slide transition
     */
    var updateAfterSlideTransition = function() {
      // if infinite loop is true
      if (slider.settings.infiniteLoop) {
        var position = '';
        // first slide
        if (slider.active.index === 0) {
          // set the new position
          position = slider.children.eq(0).position();
        // carousel, last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === getPagerQty() - 1 && slider.carousel) {
          position = slider.children.eq((getPagerQty() - 1) * getMoveBy()).position();
        // last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === slider.children.length - 1) {
          position = slider.children.eq(slider.children.length - 1).position();
        }
        if (position) {
          if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') { setPositionProperty(-position.left, 'reset', 0); }
          else if (slider.settings.mode === 'vertical') { setPositionProperty(-position.top, 'reset', 0); }
        }
      }
      // declare that the transition is complete
      slider.working = false;
      // onSlideAfter callback
      slider.settings.onSlideAfter.call(el, slider.children.eq(slider.active.index), slider.oldIndex, slider.active.index);
    };

    /**
     * Updates the auto controls state (either active, or combined switch)
     *
     * @param state (string) "start", "stop"
     *  - the new state of the auto show
     */
    var updateAutoControls = function(state) {
      // if autoControlsCombine is true, replace the current control with the new state
      if (slider.settings.autoControlsCombine) {
        slider.controls.autoEl.html(slider.controls[state]);
      // if autoControlsCombine is false, apply the "active" class to the appropriate control
      } else {
        slider.controls.autoEl.find('a').removeClass('active');
        slider.controls.autoEl.find('a:not(.bx-' + state + ')').addClass('active');
      }
    };

    /**
     * Updates the direction controls (checks if either should be hidden)
     */
    var updateDirectionControls = function() {
      if (getPagerQty() === 1) {
        slider.controls.prev.addClass('disabled');
        slider.controls.next.addClass('disabled');
      } else if (!slider.settings.infiniteLoop && slider.settings.hideControlOnEnd) {
        // if first slide
        if (slider.active.index === 0) {
          slider.controls.prev.addClass('disabled');
          slider.controls.next.removeClass('disabled');
        // if last slide
        } else if (slider.active.index === getPagerQty() - 1) {
          slider.controls.next.addClass('disabled');
          slider.controls.prev.removeClass('disabled');
        // if any slide in the middle
        } else {
          slider.controls.prev.removeClass('disabled');
          slider.controls.next.removeClass('disabled');
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Initializes the auto process
     */
    var initAuto = function() {
      // if autoDelay was supplied, launch the auto show using a setTimeout() call
      if (slider.settings.autoDelay > 0) {
        var timeout = setTimeout(el.startAuto, slider.settings.autoDelay);
      // if autoDelay was not supplied, start the auto show normally
      } else {
        el.startAuto();

        //add focus and blur events to ensure its running if timeout gets paused
        $(window).focus(function() {
          el.startAuto();
        }).blur(function() {
          el.stopAuto();
        });
      }
      // if autoHover is requested
      if (slider.settings.autoHover) {
        // on el hover
        el.hover(function() {
          // if the auto show is currently playing (has an active interval)
          if (slider.interval) {
            // stop the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.stopAuto(true);
            // create a new autoPaused value which will be used by the relative "mouseout" event
            slider.autoPaused = true;
          }
        }, function() {
          // if the autoPaused value was created be the prior "mouseover" event
          if (slider.autoPaused) {
            // start the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.startAuto(true);
            // reset the autoPaused value
            slider.autoPaused = null;
          }
        });
      }
    };

    /**

      if (getPagerQty() === 1) {
        slider.controls.prev.addClass('disabled');

    /**
     * Initializes the auto process
     */
    var initAuto = function() {
      // if autoDelay was supplied, launch the auto show using a setTimeout() call
      if (slider.settings.autoDelay > 0) {
        var timeout = setTimeout(el.startAuto, slider.settings.autoDelay);
      // if autoDelay was not supplied, start the auto show normally
      } else {
        el.startAuto();

        //add focus and blur events to ensure its running if timeout gets paused
        $(window).focus(function() {
          el.startAuto();
        }).blur(function() {
          el.stopAuto();
        });
      }
      // if autoHover is requested
      if (slider.settings.autoHover) {
        // on el hover
        el.hover(function() {
          // if the auto show is currently playing (has an active interval)
          if (slider.interval) {
            // stop the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.stopAuto(true);
            // create a new autoPaused value which will be used by the relative "mouseout" event
            slider.autoPaused = true;
          }
        }, function() {
          // if the autoPaused value was created be the prior "mouseover" event
          if (slider.autoPaused) {
            // start the auto show and pass true argument which will prevent control update
            el.startAuto(true);
            // reset the autoPaused value
            slider.autoPaused = null;
          }
        });
      }
    };

    /**
     * Check if el is on screen
     */
    var isOnScreen = function(el) {
      var win = $(window),
      viewport = {
        top: win.scrollTop(),
        left: win.scrollLeft()
      },
      bounds = el.offset();

      viewport.right = viewport.left + win.width();
      viewport.bottom = viewport.top + win.height();
      bounds.right = bounds.left + el.outerWidth();
      bounds.bottom = bounds.top + el.outerHeight();

      return (!(viewport.right < bounds.left || viewport.left > bounds.right || viewport.bottom < bounds.top || viewport.top > bounds.bottom));
    };

    /**
     * Initializes keyboard events
     */
    var keyPress = function(e) {
      var activeElementTag = document.activeElement.tagName.toLowerCase(),
      tagFilters = 'input|textarea',
      p = new RegExp(activeElementTag,['i']),
      result = p.exec(tagFilters);

      if (result == null && isOnScreen(el)) {
        if (e.keyCode === 39) {
          clickNextBind(e);
          return false;
        } else if (e.keyCode === 37) {
          clickPrevBind(e);
          return false;
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Initializes touch events
     */
    var initTouch = function() {
      // initialize object to contain all touch values
      slider.touch = {
        start: {x: 0, y: 0},
        end: {x: 0, y: 0}
      };
      slider.viewport.bind('touchstart MSPointerDown pointerdown', onTouchStart);

      //for browsers that have implemented pointer events and fire a click after
      //every pointerup regardless of whether pointerup is on same screen location as pointerdown or not
      slider.viewport.on('click', '.bxslider a', function(e) {
        if (slider.viewport.hasClass('click-disabled')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          slider.viewport.removeClass('click-disabled');
        }
      });
    };

    /**
     * Event handler for "touchstart"
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onTouchStart = function(e) {
      //disable slider controls while user is interacting with slides to avoid slider freeze that happens on touch devices when a slide swipe happens immediately after interacting with slider controls
      slider.controls.el.addClass('disabled');

      if (slider.working) {
        e.preventDefault();
        slider.controls.el.removeClass('disabled');
      } else {
        // record the original position when touch starts
        slider.touch.originalPos = el.position();
        var orig = e.originalEvent,
        touchPoints = (typeof orig.changedTouches !== 'undefined') ? orig.changedTouches : [orig];
        // record the starting touch x, y coordinates
        slider.touch.start.x = touchPoints[0].pageX;
        slider.touch.start.y = touchPoints[0].pageY;

        if (slider.viewport.get(0).setPointerCapture) {
          slider.pointerId = orig.pointerId;
          slider.viewport.get(0).setPointerCapture(slider.pointerId);
        }
        // bind a "touchmove" event to the viewport
        slider.viewport.bind('touchmove MSPointerMove pointermove', onTouchMove);
        // bind a "touchend" event to the viewport
        slider.viewport.bind('touchend MSPointerUp pointerup', onTouchEnd);
        slider.viewport.bind('MSPointerCancel pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Cancel Pointer for Windows Phone
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onPointerCancel = function(e) {
      /* onPointerCancel handler is needed to deal with situations when a touchend
      doesn't fire after a touchstart (this happens on windows phones only) */
      setPositionProperty(slider.touch.originalPos.left, 'reset', 0);

      //remove handlers
      slider.controls.el.removeClass('disabled');
      slider.viewport.unbind('MSPointerCancel pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
      slider.viewport.unbind('touchmove MSPointerMove pointermove', onTouchMove);
      slider.viewport.unbind('touchend MSPointerUp pointerup', onTouchEnd);
      if (slider.viewport.get(0).releasePointerCapture) {
        slider.viewport.get(0).releasePointerCapture(slider.pointerId);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Event handler for "touchmove"
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onTouchMove = function(e) {
      var orig = e.originalEvent,
      touchPoints = (typeof orig.changedTouches !== 'undefined') ? orig.changedTouches : [orig],
      // if scrolling on y axis, do not prevent default
      xMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x),
      yMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y),
      value = 0,
      change = 0;

      // x axis swipe
      if ((xMovement * 3) > yMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeX) {
        e.preventDefault();
      // y axis swipe
      } else if ((yMovement * 3) > xMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeY) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if (slider.settings.mode !== 'fade' && slider.settings.oneToOneTouch) {
        // if horizontal, drag along x axis
        if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.left + change;
        // if vertical, drag along y axis
        } else {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.top + change;
        }
        setPositionProperty(value, 'reset', 0);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Check if el is on screen
     */
    var isOnScreen = function(el) {
      var win = $(window),
      viewport = {
        top: win.scrollTop(),
        left: win.scrollLeft()
      },
      bounds = el.offset();

      viewport.right = viewport.left + win.width();
      viewport.bottom = viewport.top + win.height();
      bounds.right = bounds.left + el.outerWidth();
      bounds.bottom = bounds.top + el.outerHeight();

      return (!(viewport.right < bounds.left || viewport.left > bounds.right || viewport.bottom < bounds.top || viewport.top > bounds.bottom));
    };

    /**
     * Initializes keyboard events
     */
    var keyPress = function(e) {
      var activeElementTag = document.activeElement.tagName.toLowerCase(),
      tagFilters = 'input|textarea',
      p = new RegExp(activeElementTag,['i']),
      result = p.exec(tagFilters);

      if (result == null && isOnScreen(el)) {
        if (e.keyCode === 39) {
          clickNextBind(e);
          return false;
        } else if (e.keyCode === 37) {
          clickPrevBind(e);
          return false;
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Initializes touch events
     */
    var initTouch = function() {
      // initialize object to contain all touch values
      slider.touch = {
        start: {x: 0, y: 0},
        end: {x: 0, y: 0}
      };
      slider.viewport.bind('touchstart MSPointerDown pointerdown', onTouchStart);

      //for browsers that have implemented pointer events and fire a click after
      //every pointerup regardless of whether pointerup is on same screen location as pointerdown or not
      slider.viewport.on('click', '.bxslider a', function(e) {
        if (slider.viewport.hasClass('click-disabled')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          slider.viewport.removeClass('click-disabled');
        }
      });
    };

    /**
     * Event handler for "touchstart"
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onTouchStart = function(e) {
      //disable slider controls while user is interacting with slides to avoid slider freeze that happens on touch devices when a slide swipe happens immediately after interacting with slider controls
      slider.controls.el.addClass('disabled');

      if (slider.working) {
        e.preventDefault();
        slider.controls.el.removeClass('disabled');
      } else {
        // record the original position when touch starts
        slider.touch.originalPos = el.position();
        var orig = e.originalEvent,
        touchPoints = (typeof orig.changedTouches !== 'undefined') ? orig.changedTouches : [orig];
        // record the starting touch x, y coordinates
        slider.touch.start.x = touchPoints[0].pageX;
        slider.touch.start.y = touchPoints[0].pageY;

        if (slider.viewport.get(0).setPointerCapture) {
          slider.pointerId = orig.pointerId;
          slider.viewport.get(0).setPointerCapture(slider.pointerId);
        }
        // bind a "touchmove" event to the viewport
        slider.viewport.bind('touchmove MSPointerMove pointermove', onTouchMove);
        // bind a "touchend" event to the viewport
        slider.viewport.bind('touchend MSPointerUp pointerup', onTouchEnd);
        slider.viewport.bind('MSPointerCancel pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Cancel Pointer for Windows Phone
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onPointerCancel = function(e) {
      /* onPointerCancel handler is needed to deal with situations when a touchend
      doesn't fire after a touchstart (this happens on windows phones only) */
      setPositionProperty(slider.touch.originalPos.left, 'reset', 0);

      //remove handlers
      slider.controls.el.removeClass('disabled');
      slider.viewport.unbind('MSPointerCancel pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
      slider.viewport.unbind('touchmove MSPointerMove pointermove', onTouchMove);
      slider.viewport.unbind('touchend MSPointerUp pointerup', onTouchEnd);
      if (slider.viewport.get(0).releasePointerCapture) {
        slider.viewport.get(0).releasePointerCapture(slider.pointerId);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Event handler for "touchmove"
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onTouchMove = function(e) {
      var orig = e.originalEvent,
      touchPoints = (typeof orig.changedTouches !== 'undefined') ? orig.changedTouches : [orig],
      // if scrolling on y axis, do not prevent default
      xMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x),
      yMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y),
      value = 0,
      change = 0;

      // x axis swipe
      if ((xMovement * 3) > yMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeX) {
        e.preventDefault();
      // y axis swipe
      } else if ((yMovement * 3) > xMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeY) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if (slider.settings.mode !== 'fade' && slider.settings.oneToOneTouch) {
        // if horizontal, drag along x axis
        if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.left + change;
        // if vertical, drag along y axis
        } else {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.top + change;
        }
        setPositionProperty(value, 'reset', 0);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Event handler for "touchmove"
     *
     * @param e (event)
     *  - DOM event object
     */
    var onTouchMove = function(e) {
      var orig = e.originalEvent,
      touchPoints = (typeof orig.changedTouches !== 'undefined') ? orig.changedTouches : [orig],
      // if scrolling on y axis, do not prevent default
      xMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x),
      yMovement = Math.abs(touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y),
      value = 0,
      change = 0;

      // x axis swipe
      if ((xMovement * 3) > yMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeX) {
        e.preventDefault();
      // y axis swipe
      } else if ((yMovement * 3) > xMovement && slider.settings.preventDefaultSwipeY) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if (slider.settings.mode !== 'fade' && slider.settings.oneToOneTouch) {
        // if horizontal, drag along x axis
        if (slider.settings.mode === 'horizontal') {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageX - slider.touch.start.x;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.left + change;
        // if vertical, drag along y axis
        } else {
          change = touchPoints[0].pageY - slider.touch.start.y;
          value = slider.touch.originalPos.top + change;
        }
        setPositionProperty(value, 'reset', 0);
      }
    };

    /**
     * Window resize event callback
     */
    var resizeWindow = function(e) {
      // don't do anything if slider isn't initialized.
      if (!slider.initialized) { return; }
      // Delay if slider working.
      if (slider.working) {
        window.setTimeout(resizeWindow, 10);
      } else {
        // get the new window dimens (again, thank you IE)
        var windowWidthNew = $(window).width(),
        windowHeightNew = $(window).height();
        // make sure that it is a true window resize
        // *we must check this because our dinosaur friend IE fires a window resize event when certain DOM elements
        // are resized. Can you just die already?*
        if (windowWidth !== windowWidthNew || windowHeight !== windowHeightNew) {
          // set the new window dimens
          windowWidth = windowWidthNew;
          windowHeight = windowHeightNew;
          // update all dynamic elements
          el.redrawSlider();
          // Call user resize handler
          slider.settings.onSliderResize.call(el, slider.active.index);
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Adds an aria-hidden=true attribute to each element
     *
     * @param startVisibleIndex (int)
     *  - the first visible element's index
     */
    var applyAriaHiddenAttributes = function(startVisibleIndex) {
      var numberOfSlidesShowing = getNumberSlidesShowing();
      // only apply attributes if the setting is enabled and not in ticker mode
      if (slider.settings.ariaHidden && !slider.settings.ticker) {
        // add aria-hidden=true to all elements
        slider.children.attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
        // get the visible elements and change to aria-hidden=false
        slider.children.slice(startVisibleIndex, startVisibleIndex + numberOfSlidesShowing).attr('aria-hidden', 'false');
      }
    };

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator 함수
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTableGenerator(gen_tableTr, ds_tableList, {"txt_sj" : "col1"});
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 html Table의 반복부 생성
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId	generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	dsObjId		dataCollection Object ID(required)
 * @param 	_mtchJSON	{generator 컴퍼넌트 : dataCollection 컬럼} JSON(required)
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTableGenerator = function(genObjId, dsObjId, _mtchJSON) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var compNm = "";
	var genObj = null;
	var genCompObj = null;
	var dsDataObj = null;
	var dsObj = null;
	var mtchJSON = _mtchJSON || {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(dsObjId)){
		dsObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(dsObjId);
	} else if(typeof dsObjId === "object"){
		dsObj = dsObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	genCompObj = Object.keys(mtchJSON);
	dsDataObj = dsObj.getAllJSON();
	
	genObj.removeAll();
	
	for(i = 0 ; i < dsDataObj.length ; i++){
		genObj.insertChild(i);
		
		for(j = 0 ; j < genCompObj.length ; j++){
			compNm = genCompObj[j];
			genObj.getChild(i , compNm).setValue( dsObj.getCellData(i , mtchJSON[compNm]) );
		}
	}
};

itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr = function(genObjId, checkObjId, arrValuesObjId) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var arrResult = [];
	var genObj = null;
	var valuesJson = {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(!dataLib.isString(checkObjId)){
		return false;
	}
	
	for(i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++){
		valuesJson = {};
		
		if(genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).render.checked){
			valuesJson[checkObjId] = genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).getValue();
			
			if(dataLib._isArrayObj(arrValuesObjId)){
				for( j = 0; j < arrValuesObjId.length ; j++){
					valuesJson[arrValuesObjId[j]] = genObj.getChild(i , arrValuesObjId[j]).getValue();
				}
			}
			
			arrResult.push(valuesJson);
		}
	}
	
	return arrResult;
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator 함수
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTableGenerator(gen_tableTr, ds_tableList, {"txt_sj" : "col1"});
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 html Table의 반복부 생성
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId	generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	dsObjId		dataCollection Object ID(required)
 * @param 	_mtchJSON	{generator 컴퍼넌트 : dataCollection 컬럼} JSON(required)
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTableGenerator = function(genObjId, dsObjId, _mtchJSON) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var compNm = "";
	var genObj = null;
	var genCompObj = null;
	var dsDataObj = null;
	var dsObj = null;
	var mtchJSON = _mtchJSON || {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(dsObjId)){
		dsObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(dsObjId);
	} else if(typeof dsObjId === "object"){
		dsObj = dsObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	genCompObj = Object.keys(mtchJSON);
	dsDataObj = dsObj.getAllJSON();
	
	genObj.removeAll();
	
	for(i = 0 ; i < dsDataObj.length ; i++){
		genObj.insertChild(i);
		
		for(j = 0 ; j < genCompObj.length ; j++){
			compNm = genCompObj[j];
			genObj.getChild(i , compNm).setValue( dsObj.getCellData(i , mtchJSON[compNm]) );
		}
	}
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator에서 radio/checkbox checked values return 
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio", ["txt_input"]);
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio");
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 checked 된 generator의 values Array return
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId		generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	checkObjId		radio/checkbox Object ID(required)
 * @param 	arrValuesObjId	values Object Id Array
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr = function(genObjId, checkObjId, arrValuesObjId) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var arrResult = [];
	var genObj = null;
	var valuesJson = {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(!dataLib.isString(checkObjId)){
		return false;
	}
	
	for(i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++){
		valuesJson = {};
		
		if(genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).render.checked){
			valuesJson[checkObjId] = genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).getValue();
			
			if(dataLib._isArrayObj(arrValuesObjId)){
				for( j = 0; j < arrValuesObjId.length ; j++){
					valuesJson[arrValuesObjId[j]] = genObj.getChild(i , arrValuesObjId[j]).getValue();
				}
			}
			
			arrResult.push(valuesJson);
		}
	}
	
	return arrResult;
};

itbLib.fnTableGenerator = function(genObjId, dsObjId, _mtchJSON) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var compNm = "";
	var genObj = null;
	var genCompObj = null;
	var dsDataObj = null;
	var dsObj = null;
	var mtchJSON = _mtchJSON || {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(dsObjId)){
		dsObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(dsObjId);
	} else if(typeof dsObjId === "object"){
		dsObj = dsObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	genCompObj = Object.keys(mtchJSON);
	dsDataObj = dsObj.getAllJSON();
	
	genObj.removeAll();
	
	for(i = 0 ; i < dsDataObj.length ; i++){
		genObj.insertChild(i);
		
		for(j = 0 ; j < genCompObj.length ; j++){
			compNm = genCompObj[j];
			genObj.getChild(i , compNm).setValue( dsObj.getCellData(i , mtchJSON[compNm]) );
		}
	}
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator에서 radio/checkbox checked values return 
 * 사용예 :

 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio");
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 checked 된 generator의 values Array return
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId		generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	checkObjId		radio/checkbox Object ID(required)
 * @param 	arrValuesObjId	values Object Id Array
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr = function(genObjId, checkObjId, arrValuesObjId) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var arrResult = [];
	var genObj = null;
	var valuesJson = {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(!dataLib.isString(checkObjId)){
		return false;
	}
	
	for(i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++){
		valuesJson = {};
		
		if(genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).render.checked){
			valuesJson[checkObjId] = genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).getValue();
			
			if(dataLib._isArrayObj(arrValuesObjId)){
				for( j = 0; j < arrValuesObjId.length ; j++){
					valuesJson[arrValuesObjId[j]] = genObj.getChild(i , arrValuesObjId[j]).getValue();
				}
			}
			
			arrResult.push(valuesJson);
		}
	}
	
	return arrResult;
};

};

//신규 사용자 비밀번호 일치 확인
itbLib.fnUserPwdValidVrify = function(token, ref, callback, errorCallback)
{
	var id = "fnUserPwdValidVrify";
    var action = "/itb/cmn/userPwdValidVrify.do";
    var param = {};
    param['ds_param'] = {'token':token};
    if(ref instanceof Array) {
    	for(var i = 0; i < ref.length ; i++) {
    		try {
    			var obj = eval(ref[i]);
    			if ('function' == typeof obj.getJSON){
	    			param[ref[i]] = obj.getJSON();
	    		}
    		}
    		catch(e) {
    			continue;
    		}
    	}
    }
    ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, null, null, param, callback,
    errorCallback); 	
};

itbLib.fnUserPwdValidVrify = function(token, ref, callback, errorCallback)
{
	var id = "fnUserPwdValidVrify";
    var action = "/itb/cmn/userPwdValidVrify.do";
    var param = {};
    param['ds_param'] = {'token':token};
    if(ref instanceof Array) {
    	for(var i = 0; i < ref.length ; i++) {

    			var obj = eval(ref[i]);

	    		}
    		}
    		catch(e) {
    			continue;
    		}
    	}
    }
    ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, null, null, param, callback,
    errorCallback); 	
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator 함수
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTableGenerator(gen_tableTr, ds_tableList, {"txt_sj" : "col1"});
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 html Table의 반복부 생성
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId	generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	dsObjId		dataCollection Object ID(required)
 * @param 	_mtchJSON	{generator 컴퍼넌트 : dataCollection 컬럼} JSON(required)
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTableGenerator = function(genObjId, dsObjId, _mtchJSON) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var compNm = "";
	var genObj = null;
	var genCompObj = null;
	var dsDataObj = null;
	var dsObj = null;
	var mtchJSON = _mtchJSON || {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(dsObjId)){
		dsObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(dsObjId);
	} else if(typeof dsObjId === "object"){
		dsObj = dsObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	genCompObj = Object.keys(mtchJSON);
	dsDataObj = dsObj.getAllJSON();
	
	genObj.removeAll();
	
	for(i = 0 ; i < dsDataObj.length ; i++){
		genObj.insertChild(i);
		
		for(j = 0 ; j < genCompObj.length ; j++){
			compNm = genCompObj[j];
			genObj.getChild(i , compNm).setValue( dsObj.getCellData(i , mtchJSON[compNm]) );
		}
	}
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator에서 radio/checkbox checked values return 
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio", ["txt_input"]);
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio");
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 checked 된 generator의 values Array return
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId		generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	checkObjId		radio/checkbox Object ID(required)
 * @param 	arrValuesObjId	values Object Id Array
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr = function(genObjId, checkObjId, arrValuesObjId) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var arrResult = [];
	var genObj = null;
	var valuesJson = {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(!dataLib.isString(checkObjId)){
		return false;
	}
	
	for(i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++){
		valuesJson = {};
		
		if(genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).render.checked){
			valuesJson[checkObjId] = genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).getValue();
			
			if(dataLib._isArrayObj(arrValuesObjId)){
				for( j = 0; j < arrValuesObjId.length ; j++){
					valuesJson[arrValuesObjId[j]] = genObj.getChild(i , arrValuesObjId[j]).getValue();
				}
			}
			
			arrResult.push(valuesJson);
		}
	}
	
	return arrResult;
};

	var link = '/w2/itb/itb/nat/lyrIntrExpectInqire01.xml';	// 예금
	if ( 'I' == options.type ) {	
		link = '/w2/itb/itb/nat/lyrIntrExpectInqire02.xml';	// 적금
		options.height = 308;	// 등록창사이즈
	}

	common.gfnOpenPopup(link, {width: options.width, height : options.height, param : options.param });
}


/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 셀렉트박스 선택 시 잔액 조회
 * 사용예 :
 * 		itbLib.fnBlceInqr('1111', {"dpstBlce" : "em_dpstBlce", "defrayAvBlce": "em_defrayAvBlce"});
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 계좌의 잔액을 조회 후 해당 위치에 잔액을 표시한다.
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	val			계좌번호(required)
 * @param 	_options	잔액 표시 필드 세팅 options 
 * 				{
 * 					"dpstBlce" : "em_dpstBlce"				// 예금잔액 필드
 * 					, "defrayAvBlce" : "em_defrayAvBlce"	// 출금가능액 필드
 * 				}
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.blceInqrChangeDiv = {};

itbLib.fnSelectBlceInqr = function(val, _changeDiv) {
	itbLib.blceInqrChangeDiv = _changeDiv || { "dpstBlce" : "em_dpstBlce", "defrayAvBlce" : "em_defrayAvBlce"};
	
	if( !dataLib.isString(val) || dataLib.isEmpty(val) ){
		// 예금잔액 필드 세팅
		WebSquare.util.getComponentById(itbLib.blceInqrChangeDiv["dpstBlce"]).setValue("0");
		
		// 출금가능액 필드 세팅
		WebSquare.util.getComponentById(itbLib.blceInqrChangeDiv["defrayAvBlce"]).setValue("0");
		return false;
	}
	
	ajaxLib.callSubmission("fnSelectBlceInqr", "/itb/itb/inq/selectBlceInqr.do", null, null, {"ds_param" : {"acnutNo" : val}}, "itbLib.fnSelectBlceInqrCallback");
	
};

//신규 사용자 비밀번호 일치 확인
itbLib.fnUserPwdValidVrify = function(token, ref, callback, errorCallback)
{
	var id = "fnUserPwdValidVrify";
    var action = "/itb/cmn/userPwdValidVrify.do";
    var param = {};
    param['ds_param'] = {'token':token};
    if(ref instanceof Array) {
    	for(var i = 0; i < ref.length ; i++) {
    		try {
    			var obj = eval(ref[i]);
    			if ('function' == typeof obj.getJSON){
	    			param[ref[i]] = obj.getJSON();
	    		}
    		}
    		catch(e) {
    			continue;
    		}
    	}
    }
    ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, null, null, param, callback,
    errorCallback); 	
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator 함수
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTableGenerator(gen_tableTr, ds_tableList, {"txt_sj" : "col1"});
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 html Table의 반복부 생성
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId	generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	dsObjId		dataCollection Object ID(required)
 * @param 	_mtchJSON	{generator 컴퍼넌트 : dataCollection 컬럼} JSON(required)
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTableGenerator = function(genObjId, dsObjId, _mtchJSON) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var compNm = "";
	var genObj = null;
	var genCompObj = null;
	var dsDataObj = null;
	var dsObj = null;
	var mtchJSON = _mtchJSON || {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(dsObjId)){
		dsObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(dsObjId);
	} else if(typeof dsObjId === "object"){
		dsObj = dsObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	genCompObj = Object.keys(mtchJSON);
	dsDataObj = dsObj.getAllJSON();
	
	genObj.removeAll();
	
	for(i = 0 ; i < dsDataObj.length ; i++){
		genObj.insertChild(i);
		
		for(j = 0 ; j < genCompObj.length ; j++){
			compNm = genCompObj[j];
			genObj.getChild(i , compNm).setValue( dsObj.getCellData(i , mtchJSON[compNm]) );
		}
	}
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 테이블 Generator에서 radio/checkbox checked values return 
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio", ["txt_input"]);
 *     	itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr(gen_tableTr, "txt_radio");
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 checked 된 generator의 values Array return
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	genObjId		generator Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	checkObjId		radio/checkbox Object ID(required)
 * @param 	arrValuesObjId	values Object Id Array
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnTbGenChkObjArr = function(genObjId, checkObjId, arrValuesObjId) {
	var i = 0;
	var j = 0;
	var arrResult = [];
	var genObj = null;
	var valuesJson = {};
	
	if(dataLib.isString(genObjId)){
		genObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(genObjId);
	} else if(typeof genObjId === "object"){
		genObj = genObjId;
	} else {
		return false;
	}
	
	if(!dataLib.isString(checkObjId)){
		return false;
	}
	
	for(i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++){
		valuesJson = {};
		
		if(genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).render.checked){
			valuesJson[checkObjId] = genObj.getChild(i , checkObjId).getValue();
			
			if(dataLib._isArrayObj(arrValuesObjId)){
				for( j = 0; j < arrValuesObjId.length ; j++){
					valuesJson[arrValuesObjId[j]] = genObj.getChild(i , arrValuesObjId[j]).getValue();
				}
			}
			
			arrResult.push(valuesJson);
		}
	}
	
	return arrResult;
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 페이징 네비게이션 처리
 * 사용예 :
 *     	itbLib.fnPaginator(paging, resBody.total, ds_param.get("page"));	// 페이지 네비게이션 세팅
 * </pre>
 * 위의 예에서 pageList 컴퍼넌트에 페이징 세팅 된다
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	plObjId		pageList Object ID(required)		
 * @param 	totcnt		총건수(required)
 * @param 	page			페이지 번호(required defaulte 1)
 * @param 	rows			페이지 row 수(default 10)
 * @param 	pageNvgSize 	페이지 pageNvgSize 수(default 5)
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.fnPaginator = function(plObjId, totcnt, page, rows, pageNvgSize){
	var plObj = null;
	
	if (typeof plObjId === "string") {
		plObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(plObjId);
		
		if (plObjId === undefined) {
			return false;
		}
		
	} else if (typeof plObjId === "object") {
		plObj = plObjId;
	} 
	
	totcnt =  WebSquare.util.parseInt(totcnt, 0);
	page =  WebSquare.util.parseInt(page, 1);
	rows =  WebSquare.util.parseInt(rows, 10);
	pageNvgSize =  WebSquare.util.parseInt(pageNvgSize, 10);
	
	
	plObj.setPageSize(pageNvgSize);
	
	plObj.hide();
	
	if(0 < totcnt){
		plObj.setCount(Math.ceil(totcnt / rows));
		plObj.setSelectedIndex(page);
		plObj.show();
	}
}

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : setDatePeriod 메서드는 현재날짜로 부터의 기간 셋팅
 * </pre>
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param   Start Form Field Object
 * @param   End Form Field Object
 * @param   +/- Period (-1y, -1m, -1d)
 * @author  김호훈
 */
itbLib.setDatePeriod = function(fromObj, toObj, period){
	
	var nowDate= dataLib.getDate('yyyyMMdd');
	var startDt = "";
	
	switch ( period ) {
		case 0:
			period = '0d';	// 당일
			break;
		case 1:
			period = '-3d';	// 3일전
			break;
		case 2:
			period = '-7d';	// 7일전
			break;
		case 3:
			period = '-15d';	// 15일전
			break;
		case 4:
			period = '-1m';	// 1개원전
			break;
		case 5:
			period = '-3m';	// 3개월전
			break;
		case 6:
			period = '-6m';	// 6개월전
			break;
		case 7:
			period = '-12m';	// 1년전
			break;
	}
	
	
	startDt = itbLib.getTermDate(nowDate, period);
	
	fromObj.setValue(startDt);
	toObj.setValue(nowDate);
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : setDatePeriod 메서드는 fromObj로부터의 기간 셋팅
 * </pre>
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param   Start Form Field Object
 * @param   End Form Field Object
 * @param   +/- Period (-1y, -1m, -1d)
 * @author  김호훈
 */
itbLib.setDatePeriod2 = function(fromObj, toObj, period){
	
	var nowDate= fromObj.getValue();
	var trgDate = "";
	
	switch ( period ) {
		case 0:
			period = '0d';	// 당일
			break;
		case 1:
			period = '-3d';	// 3일전
			break;
		case 2:
			period = '-7d';	// 7일전
			break;
		case 3:
			period = '-15d';// 15일전
			break;
		case 4:
			period = '-1m';	// 1개원전
			break;
		case 5:
			period = '-3m';	// 3개월전
			break;
		case 6:
			period = '-6m';	// 6개월전
			break;
		case 7:
			period = '-12m';// 1년전
			break;
	}
	
	trgDate = itbLib.getTermDate(nowDate, period);
	
	fromObj.setValue(nowDate);
	toObj.setValue(trgDate);
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : pYmd 기준으로 기간 반환
 * </pre>
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param   string pYmd	
 * @param   string +/- Period (-1y, -1m, -1d)
 * @param   object _options
 * 						_options.isbfDay : 이전일 기준 여부
 * @author  이의창
 */
itbLib.getTermDate = function(pYmd, period, _options) {
	var retDate = "";
	var term = 0;
	var year = 0;
    var month = 0;
    var day = 0;
    var lastDay = 0;
	var pYmdObj = null;
	var options = _options || {isbfDay : false};
	
	if((!dataLib.isString(pYmd) || "" == pYmd) && (!dataLib.isString(period) || "" == period)) {
		return retDate; 
	}
 
	try {
		var s = period.substring(0, period.length-1);
		
		if(s.length == 0) {
			return retDate;	
		}
		
		term = dataLib.parseInt(s);
	} catch(e) {
		return retDate;
	}
	
	
	if (period.lastIndexOf("y") > -1 || period.lastIndexOf("m") > -1){
		pYmdObj = dataLib.parseDate(pYmd, "yyyyMMdd");
		year = pYmdObj.getFullYear();
		month = pYmdObj.getMonth();	// month은 0 ~ 11 (0 : 1월 ~ 11 : 12월)
		day = pYmdObj.getDate();
		
		if(period.lastIndexOf("y") > -1){
			year = year + term;
		}else if(period.lastIndexOf("m") > -1){
			pYmdObj = new Date(year, month + term, 1);
			year = pYmdOb

>>> HIT ISA @ 18546
1);
			year = pYmdObj.getFullYear();
			month = pYmdObj.getMonth();	// month은 0 ~ 11 (0 : 1월 ~ 11 : 12월)
		}
	    
		lastDay = dataLib.parseInt(itbLib.getLastDay(year, month+1));
		
		if(lastDay < day){
			day = lastDay;
		}
		
		if(!options.isbfDay){
			if(0 < term){
				day = day - 1;
			} else if(0 > term){
				day = day + 1;
			}
		}
		
		retDate = WebSquare.date.getFormattedDate( new Date(year, month, day) , "yyyyMMdd" );
		
	}else if (period.lastIndexOf("d") > -1){
		
		if(!options.isbfDay){
			if(0 < term){
				term = term - 1;
			} else if(0 > term){
				term = term + 1;
			}
		}
		
		retDate = dataLib.addDay(pYmd, term);
	}
	
	return retDate;
 
}

/**
 * <pre> 
 	사용 예)
 	
 	1. 최소일 : 오늘로부터 5년 전, 최대일 : 오늘
 	var nowDate = dataLib.getDate('yyyyMMdd');
	var minDate = dataLib.addYear(nowDate, -5);
	var maxDate = nowDate;
	itbLib.setRangeDate(ibx_inqrBgnde, minDate, maxDate);
	
	2. 최소일 : 오늘로부터 1개월 후, 최대일 : 최소일로부터 36개월 후
	var nowDate = dataLib.getDate('yyyyMMdd');
	var minDate = dataLib.addMonth(nowDate, 1);
	var maxDate = dataLib.addMonth(minDate, 35);
	itbLib.setRangeDate(ibx_inqrBgnde, minDate, maxDate);
	
 * </pre>
 * @param	inputCalendarObjectId (WebSquare.uiplugin.inputCalendar)	: InputCalendar 컴포넌트 ID 혹은 Object
 * @param	optionalMinDateString (string)								: 최소 일자 문자열 (optional : 없을 시 최소일자 처리안함)
 * @param	optionalMaxDateString (string)								: 최대 일자 문자열 (optional : 없을 시 최대일자 처리안함)
 * @param	optionalDateFormat (string)									: 날짜 포맷 (optional : 없을 시 yyyyMMdd 로 적용)
 */
itbLib.setRangeDate = function (inputCalendarObjectId, optionalMinDateString, optionalMaxDateString, optionalDateFormat){

	optionalDateFormat = optionalDateFormat || 'yyyyMMdd';
	
	var inputCalendarObject;
	if(dataLib.isString(inputCalendarObjectId)){
		inputCalendarObject = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(inputCalendarObjectId);
	} else if(typeof inputCalendarObjectId === "object"){
		inputCalendarObject = inputCalendarObjectId;
	} else { throw new Error('입력파라미터 오류입니다.'); }
	if(!(inputCalendarObject instanceof WebSquare.uiplugin.inputCalendar)){ throw new Error('입력파라미터 오류입니다.'); }
	
	if(dataLib.isString(optionalMinDateString)){
		if(!(dataLib.parseDate(optionalMinDateString, optionalDateFormat) instanceof Date)) { throw new Error('입력파라미터 오류입니다.'); }
		var minYear = itbLib.fnDateFormatter(optionalMinDateString, optionalDateFormat, 'yyyy');
		inputCalendarObject.setMinYear(minYear);
		inputCalendarObject.disableBeforeDate(optionalMinDateString);
		inputCalendarObject.setUserData('minDate', optionalMinDateString);
	}
	
	if(dataLib.isString(optionalMaxDateString)){
		if(!(dataLib.parseDate(optionalMaxDateString, optionalDateFormat) instanceof Date)) { throw new Error('입력파라미터 오류입니다.'); }
		var maxYear = itbLib.fnDateFormatter(optionalMaxDateString, optionalDateFormat, 'yyyy');
		inputCalendarObject.setMaxYear(maxYear);
		inputCalendarObject.disableAfterDate(optionalMaxDateString);
		inputCalendarObject.setUserData('maxDate', optionalMaxDateString);
	}
	
	if(null != inputCalendarObject.getUserData('maxDate') || null != inputCalendarObject.getUserData('minDate')) {
		inputCalendarObject.setUserData('dateFormat', optionalDateFormat);
	}
	
};

/**
 * 웹스퀘어 inputCalendar 공통 날짜 validator
 */
itbLib.fnDateValidator = function(value, compObjId){
	var d = new Date(WebSquare.util.setDate(value));
	var compObj = WebSquare.util.getComponentById(compObjId);
	if(!(d instanceof Date) || isNaN(d.getTime()) || (dataLib.parseDate(compObj.getUserData('minDate'), compObj.getUserData('dateFormat')) instanceof Date && value < compObj.getUserData('minDate')) || (dataLib.parseDate(compObj.getUserData('maxDate'), compObj.getUserData('dateFormat')) instanceof Date && value > compObj.getUserData('maxDate'))){
		compObj.rollback();
	}
	return compObj.getValue();
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : getLastDay 메서드는 현재 년월에 대한 일수를 반환한다.
 * </pre>
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param   Year Object
 * @param   Month Object
 * @return  Day Count
 * @author  김호훈
 */
itbLib.getLastDay = function (year, month) {
	var lastDays = new Array("31", "28", "31", "30", "31", "30", "31", "31", "30", "31", "30", "31");
	var selDay	= lastDays[month - 1];

	if( 2 == month ) {
		if(year % 400 == 0 || (year % 100 != 0 && year % 4 == 0)) {
			selDay = "29";
		}
	}else if ( month == "" ){
		selDay	= "0";
	}

	return selDay;
};

/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 전각 2바이트를 반각 1바이트로 변환
 * </pre>
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param   val
 * @return  String
 * @author  김호훈
 */
itbLib.getFullToHalfChar = function (val) {
	var s = new String();
	var len = val.length;
	var c;
	for ( var i=0 ; i < len ; i++ ) {
		c = val.charCodeAt(i);
		if ( c >= 65281 && c <= 65374 && c != 65340 ) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(c-65248);
		} else if ( c == 8217) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(39);
		} else if ( c == 8221) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(34);
		} else if ( c == 12288) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(32);
		} else if ( c == 65507) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(126);
		} else if ( c == 65509) {
			s += String.fromCharCode(92);
		} else {
			s += val.charAt(i);
		}
	}
	
	return s;
};

itbLib.fnCreatSelectBoxAcnutNo = function(opt){
	var options = {

			, selectBoxObj	: opt.selectBoxObj || null
			, selectedVal 	: opt.selectedVal || ''
			, selectedIdx 	: opt.selectedIdx || 0
			, fnCallBack 	: opt.fnCallBack || null
			, ignoreNoAcnutError   : opt.ignoreNoAcnutError || false // 계좌 없음 에러 무시 여부
		};
	
	// 계좌 options
	var obj = options.selectBoxObj;
	
	// 계좌정보를 조회
	var param = {
			action : '/itb/cmn/cstmrinfoAcnutNoList.do?acnutNoTy=' + options.acnutNoTy
			, mode : "synchronous"
			, method : 'POST'
			, mediatype : 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
			// 성공시
			, success :  function(rst) {
					// 계좌목록
					var dataList = rst.responseJSON.ds_cmnCstmrAcnutList;
					
					if ( null == dataList || "object" != typeof dataList || (!options.ignoreNoAcnutError && 0 >= dataList.length) ) {
						alert("계좌정보를 조회할 수 없습니다.\n잠시후 이용하세요.");
						window.location.href="/";
						return false;
					}
					
					for (var i=0 ; i < dataList.length ; i++ ) {
						obj.addItem(dataList[i].acnutNo, itbLib.fnDbsbAccountFormatter(dataList[i].acnutNo));
					}
					
					// selected
					obj.setSelectedIndex(options.selectedIdx);
					
					// default가 있을 경우 selected
					if ( '' != options.selectedVal ) {
						obj.setValue(options.selectedVal);
					}
					
					// callback 함수가 있을 경우
					if ( typeof options.fnCallBack === "function" ) {
						options.fnCallBack();
					}
					
				}
			, error : function( e ){
			    alert("계좌정보를 조회할 수 없습니다.\n잠시후 이용하세요.");
			    return false;
			}
		};
	// 서버전송
	$w.ajax(param);
}

 * @author  김봉진
 */
itbLib.fnAtchmnflExtsnNm = function(fileExtsnNm){
	
		var	retCl= "btn icon";

		if(-1!=fileExtsnNm.indexOf("doc")){
			retCl= "btn icon doc";
			
		}else if(-1!=fileExtsnNm.indexOf("hwp")){
			retCl= "btn icon hwp";
				
		}else if(-1!=fileExtsnNm.indexOf("pdf")){
			retCl= "btn icon pdf";
			
		}else if(-1!=fileExtsnNm.indexOf("xls")){
			retCl= "btn icon xls";
			
		} else {
			retCl= "btn icon";
			
		}
	
	return retCl;
}

/**
 * 계좌상세조회 팝업 open
 * @param acnutNo	계좌번호
 * @param type      입출금[R], 예금[D], 적금[S], 대출[L]
 * @author  심원보
 */
itbLib.fnWinOpenAcnutDtlInqr = function(acnutNo, type){
	if (!(/^[0-9]{11}$/.test(acnutNo) || /^[0-9]{14}$/.test(acnutNo)) || !('R' == type || 'D' == type || 'S' == type || 'L' == type)) {
		throw new Error('입력파라미터 오류입니다.');
	}
	var id = {
		'R' : 'acnutDtlInqr1',
		'D' : 'acnutDtlInqr2',
		'S' : 'acnutDtlInqr3',
		'L' : 'acnutDtlInqr4'
	};
	var url = {
		'R' : '/w2/itb/itb/inq/popAcnutDtlInqr01.xml',
		'D' : '/w2/itb/itb/inq/popAcnutDtlInqr02.xml',
		'S' : '/w2/itb/itb/inq/popAcnutDtlInqr03.xml',
		'L' : '/w2/itb/itb/inq/popAcnutDtlInqr04.xml'
	};
	var height = {
		'R' : 731,
		'D' : 761,
		'S' : 761,
		'L' : 520
	};
	var options = {
		type : "window",
		title : "계좌상세정보",
		width : 752,
		height : height[type],
		left : 50,
		top : 50,
		popupParam : {
			'acnutNo' : acnutNo
		}
	};
	comLib.openPopup(id[type], url[type], options);
};

/**
 * @description DB저축은행 계좌번호 Formatter
 * @type  function
 * @access public
 * @param accountString	계좌번호문자열(rqruied 숫자만)
 * @param bankCd		은행코드	
 * @author 심원보
 */
itbLib.fnDbsbAccountFormatter = function(accountString, _bankCd){
	var bankCd = _bankCd || "000";
	
	if("undefined" != typeof bankCd && "000" != bankCd){
		return accountString;
	}
	
	if(/^[0-9]{11}$/.test(accountString)){
		return accountString.replace(/^([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{7})$/,"$1-$2-$3");
	}else if(/^[0-9]{14}$/.test(accountString)){
		return accountString.replace(/^([0-9]{3})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{7})$/,"$1-$2-$3-$4");
	}else{
		return accountString;
	}
};

/**
 * @description 평생계좌번호 Formatter
 * @type  function
 * @access public
 * @param  strLftmAcnutno
 * @author 김영재
 */
itbLib.fnLftmAcnutNoFormatter = function( strLftmAcnuNo ){
	return strLftmAcnuNo.replace(/^([0-9]{3})([0-9]{8})$/,"$1-$2");
};

/**
 * 사용예) itbLib.fnDateFormatter("20180101", "yyyyMMdd", "yyyy.MM.dd");
 * 
 * @description 날짜 formatter
 * @type  function
 * @access public
 * @param dateString		날짜문자열
 * @param inputPattern		입력패턴 (default : yyyyMMdd)
 * @param outputPattern		출력패턴 (default : yyyy.MM.dd)
 * @author 심원보
 */
itbLib.fnTransWonToKorean =function(amt) {
	var numWon = dataLib.parseInt(amt);
	
	var won = "영 원";
	
	if (numWon != 0) {
		won = dataLib.transKoreanWon(numWon) +" 원";
	}
	
	return won;
};

/**
 * 사용예) itbLib.fnDateFormatter("20180101", "yyyyMMdd", "yyyy.MM.dd");
 * 
 * @description 날짜 formatter
 * @type  function
 * @access public
 * @param dateString		날짜문자열
 * @param inputPattern		입력패턴 (default : yyyyMMdd)
 * @param outputPattern		출력패턴 (default : yyyy.MM.dd)
 * @author 심원보
 */
itbLib.fnTransWonToKorean =function(amt) {
	var numWon = dataLib.parseInt(amt);
	
	var won = "영 원";
	
	if (numWon != 0) {
		won = dataLib.transKoreanWon(numWon) +" 원";
	}
	
	return won;
};

	}else if ( 'C2003' == opt.procSe ) {
		opt.procSe = '13';	// E-자유적금예금
	}
	
	// 파라미터 셋팅
	itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt = $.extend({}, itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt, opt);
	
	// 고객확인 대상여부 조회
	ajaxLib.callSubmission("fnPubCstmrCnfirmSysAt", "/itb/cmn/cstmrCnfirmSysAt.do", null, null, null, "itbLib.fnPubCstmrCnfirmSysAtCallBack", itbLib.fnPubCstmrCnfirmSysAtErrCallBack);
};

/**
 * 자금세탁방지 : 고객확인 대상여부 조회 callback
 */
itbLib.fnPubCstmrCnfirmSysAtCallBack = function(resbody, e, id) {
	
	var data = resbody.ds_pubCnfirmTrget;
	
	if ( '01' == data.cnfirmTrgetAt ) {	// 01 CDD 대상
		if ( '0' == data.cstmrTy ) {
			// 개인
			common.changeTab('/w2/itb/cmn/cstmrCnfirmSys.xml');
		}else{
			// 법인
			common.changeTab('/w2/itb/cmn/cprCstmrCnfirmSys.xml');
		}
	}else{
		// 페이지이동
		if ( null != itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt['returnURL'] ) {
			common.changeTab(itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt['returnURL'], itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt['returnParam']);
		}
		if ( null != itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt['returnFunction'] ) {
			itbLib.pubCstmrCnfirmSysOpt['returnFunction']();
		}
	}
};

/**
 * 자금세탁방지 : 고객확인 대상여부 조회 err callback
 */
itbLib.fnPubCstmrCnfirmSysAtErrCallBack = function(resbody, e, id) {
	var resJSON = JSON.parse(e.responseText);
	if ( 'itb.cmn.error.0006' == resJSON.errorCode) {
		// 이전페이지로 이동
		common.changeTab('/w2/itb/lgn/login.xml', null, null, null, 2, -1);
	}
};

/**
 * 증명서 리포트 팝업 호출
 *  -> reportCd 종류
 *  - 0 : 예금잔액증명서 미리보기
 *  - 1 : 예금잔액증명서
 *  - 2 : 부체증명서 미리보기
 *  - 3 : 부체증명서 
 *  - 4 : 금융거래확인서 미리보기
 *  - 5 : 금융거래확인서 
 *  - 6 : 부채증명원(햇살론) 미리보기
 *  - 7 : 부채증명원(햇살론) 
 *  - 8 : 원천징수영수증 미리보기
 *  - 9 : 원천징수영수증
 */
itbLib.fnOpenUbiReport = function(opt){
	if ( '' == opt.reportCd ) {
		alert('리포트 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
		return false;
	}
	
	// report wframe reload
	pubIncUbiReport.setSrc(pubIncUbiReport.getSrc());
	
	// wframe에서 호출하는 xml의 함수를 호출하여 report를 호출한다.
	scwin.fnPubIncUbiRepostData(opt);
};

/**
 * 주말 여부
 * @param string (yyyyMMdd) : 일자
 * @return boolean : 주말 여부
 */
itbLib.fnIsWeekend = function(dateString) {
	var d = new Date(WebSquare.util.setDate(dateString));
	return (d instanceof Date && !isNaN(d.getTime()) && (dataLib.getDay(dateString) === '일요일' || dataLib.getDay(dateString) === '토요일'));
};

/**
 * Generator 사용한 그리드의 row의 column마다 같은 row의 column 데이터로 title을 셋팅한다.
 * 	ex] itbLib.setGeneratorCellTitle(gnt_genTableT, 'choise', 'lonknd');
 * @param string (yyyyMMdd) : 일자
 * @return boolean : 주말 여부
 */
itbLib.setGeneratorCellTitle = function(genObj, target, source) {
	if ( 0 < genObj.getLength() ) {
		for (var i=0 ; i < genObj.getLength() ; i++ ) {
			genObj.getChild(i, target).setTitle(genObj.getChild(i, source).getValue());
		}
	}
};

/**
 * 브라우져 타이틀을 네비게이션의 정보를 이용하여 변경한다.
 * 	- addText : 추가할 텍스트
 * 	- isFirstDel : 맨앞의 텍스트를 삭제할 경우 true
 */
itbLib.setWindowTitle = function(addText, isFirstDel){
	var div = ' < ';
	
	// 추가할 텍스트에 대한 셋팅
	if ( null == addText ) addText = '';
	
	// 맨앞의 텍스트를 삭제할 경우 
	if ( null != isFirstDel && isFirstDel ) {
		var strBuffer = new StringBuffer();
		var arr = itbLib.gbTitle.split(div);

		for ( var i=arr.length-1 ; i > 0 ; i-- ) {
			strBuffer.append(div + arr[i]);
		}
		
		document.title = addText + strBuffer.toString();
	}else{
		if ( '' != addText ) {
			addText = addText + div;
		}
		// 브라우져 타이틀 변경
//		$('title').html(addText + ' > ' + $('#genLocation > span').eq($('#genLocation > span').size()-1).html() + ' > DBBank');
		document.title = addText + itbLib.gbTitle;
	}
};

itbLib.initUserNm = function(callback)
{
	var id = "fnInitUserNm";
	var action = "/itb/lgn/initUserNm.do";
	ajaxLib.callSubmission(id, action, null, null, null, callback);	
};

/**
 * (2019.05.08) 보안매체체크

itbLib.fnOTPUseSeCheck = function(oCallback) {

        type     : "POST",

		dataType : 'json',
		success  : function(data){
			oCallback(data.OTPUseSe);
		},
		error    : function(xhr, textStatus, errorThrown){
			oCallback("");
		}
    });
};

itbLib.setWindowTitle = function(addText, isFirstDel){

	}
};

/**
 * Session 체크 타이머
 *   : 종료시간이 되면 지정된 oCallbackFnc을 호출한다.
 * 
 * @date 2018.04.16
 * @memberOf 장목비
 * @param {String}   타이머ID
 * @param {String}   Callback 함수명
 * @example
 * stlLib.chkSessionTimer( oTimerId );
 */
stlLib.chkSessionTimer = function ( oTimerId )
{
	console.log("=======> SESSION START <=======");
	
	// Timer 초기화
	stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
	
	// Timer 설정(10분)
	$w.setInterval( function(){
		console.log("=======> SESSION END   <=======");
		
		// 지정된 시간이 되면 Timer해제
		stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
		
		// TimeOver시 alert후 초기페이지로 
		stlLib.sessionTimeOver();
		
	} , {delay:parseInt(600000), key:oTimerId} );
};

/**
 * Session 체크 타이머 Clear
 * @date 2018.04.16
 * @memberOf 장목비
 * @param {String}  타이머ID 
 * @example
 * stlLib.clearSessionTimer('timerKey');
 */
stlLib.clearSessionTimer = function( oTimerId )
{
	$w.clearInterval(oTimerId);	
};

/**
 * Session TimeOver
 * @date 2018.04.16
 * @memberOf 장목비
 * @example
 * stlLib.sessionTimeOver()
 */
stlLib.sessionTimeOver = function()
{
	alert("입력가능시간이 만료되었습니다.\n초기페이지로 돌아갑니다.");
	
	var initUrl = stlLib.fnGoScrcmpnUrl(stlLib.fnGetScrcmpnCd());
		initUrl = initUrl.replaceAll("/websquare/websquare.jsp?w2xPath=", ""); 
	
	// 페이지이동
	common.changeTabStl(initUrl);
};

/**
 * 대출금리정보 리턴(json)
 * 
 * @param callback : json 형태의 결과가 리턴될 Callback함수
 */
stlLib.fnGetJsonStlInrst = function( strCallback ) {
	
    $.ajax({
        type:"POST",  
        url:'/stl/selectStlInrst.do',
        data:"scrcmpnCd=" + stlLib.fnGetScrcmpnCd(),
		dataType:'json',
		success: function(data)
		{
			strCallback( JSON.stringify(data.stlInrst) );
		},
		error: function(xhr, textStatus, errorThrown)
		{
			strCallback("");
		}
    });
};

/**
 * 대출금리정보 리턴(text)
 * 
 * @param callback : text 형태의 결과가 리턴될 Callback함수
 */
stlLib.fnGetCurStlInrst = function(strCallback)
{
	var rtnTxt = '';
	
	$.ajax({
        type:"POST",  
        url:'/stl/selectStlInrst.do',
        data:"scrcmpnCd=" + stlLib.fnGetScrcmpnCd(),
		dataType:'json',
		success: function(data)
		{
			strCallback(stlLib.gfnLonInrstWords(data.stlInrst.lonInrst, data.stlInrst.extnInrst));
		},
		error: function(xhr, textStatus, errorThrown)
		{
			strCallback(rtnTxt);
		}
    });
};

/**
 * 대출금리 안내문구
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 신규금리와 연장금리를 입력 받아 대출조건 상의 대출금리 안내문구로 리턴
 * </pre>
 * @param newInrst : 신규금리
 * @param extnInrst : 연장금리
 */
stlLib.gfnLonInrstWords = function( newInrst, extnInrst )
{	
	var rtnTxt = ""
		rtnTxt += "신규금리 " +  newInrst + "%";

		// (2021.07.21) '99' 입력시 연장시점의 금리로 치환
		if(extnInrst == "99"){
			rtnTxt += " (연장시 변경될 수 있음(혼합금리))";
		}else{
			rtnTxt += ", 연장시금리 " + extnInrst + "%";
		}
		
	return rtnTxt;
};


/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 데이터맵을 구성할 Json 배열을 받아 파라미터로 넘어온 JsonObject를
 * 			각각의 dataMap 및 dataList로 각각 담아준다.  
 *
 * 사용예 :
 * 		var arrDs = [ {"dsNm":"ds_nextValue", "dsKey":"nextValue"}
 *				    , {"dsNm":"ds_resMsg", "dsKey":"resMsg", "dsType":"dataMap"}	// 데이터맵 동적생성시
 *				    , {"dsNm":"ds_allLonList", "dsKey":"lonList"} ];
 *	    stlLib.fnSetParam2DS(arrDs);
 * </pre>
 * 
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	arrData			JSON 형태(required)
 * 			------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 			  § dsNm	[필수] : 데이터맵 이름
 * 			  § dsKey	[필수] : 이전화면에서 데이터를 넘길 때 사용한 Key값
 * 			  § dsType  (default - dataMap)	
 * 						 : 해당화면의 dataCollection에 해당 dsNm이 정의가 되어있지 않을 때, 
 *               	  	  'dataMap' or 'dataList'를 지정해주면 동적으로 데이터맵을 생성 후 해당 값을 담는다.
 *          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
 * @return  void
 */
stlLib.fnSetParam2DS = function ( arrData ){
	// 데이터맵 변수 초기화
	var strDsNm, strDsKey, strDsType;	// 데이터맵 이름, Column, Type(dataMap, dataList)
	var arrDsKey = null; 				// 데이터맵 Column 배열
	
	// 이전 페이지 전송 값 가져옴
	var jsObj = common.getParameter();
	if(typeof jsObj === "string"){
		jsObj = JSON.parse(jsObj);
	};
	
	// E2E Parameter가 존재시 전역변수에 저장
	for(var inx in jsObj) {
		if("e2eParam" == stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[inx])){
			stlLib.e2eParam = jsObj[inx]["e2eParam"];
			break;
		}
	}
	
	// DataMap 생성 및 저장
	for(var inx=0 ; inx < arrData.length ; inx++)
	{	
		strDsNm   = arrData[inx].dsNm;
		strDsKey  = arrData[inx].dsKey;
		strDsType = "";
		arrDsKey  = [];
		
		for(var iny=0 ; iny < jsObj.length ; iny++) {
			// Key값이 동일하면 strDsNm에 담긴 데이터맵(리스트)에 해당하는 값에 입력
			if(strDsKey == stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny])) {
				
				// DataObject가 존재하지 않는다면 신규생성
				if( WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === undefined
					|| WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === null )
				{
					strDsType = (arrData[inx].dsType !== undefined) ? arrData[inx].dsType : "dataMap";	// 타입 dafault : 'dataMap'
					arrDsKey  = (strDsType == "dataMap") 
								? stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]])
								: stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]][0])	 		// 데이터맵 Column 배열생성
					common.cfnCreateDataList( strDsNm, strDsType, stlLib.fnGetColInfo(arrDsKey) );		// 데이터셋 생성
				}
				
				eval(strDsNm).setJSON(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]]);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	
};

lLib.setWindowTitle = function(addText, isFirstDel){
	var div = ' < ';
	
	// 추가할 텍스트에 대한 셋팅
	if ( null == addText ) addText = '';
	
	// 맨앞의 텍스트를 삭제할 경우 
	if ( null != isFirstDel && isFirstDel ) {
		var strBuffer = new StringBuffer();
		var arr = stlLib.gbTitle.split(div);

		for ( var i=arr.length-1 ; i > 0 ; i-- ) {
			strBuffer.append(div + arr[i]);
		}
		
		document.title = addText + strBuffer.toString();
	}else{
		if ( '' != addText ) {
			addText = addText + div;
		}
		// 브라우져 타이틀 변경
//		$('title').html(addText + ' > ' + $('#genLocation > span').eq($('#genLocation > span').size()-1).html() + ' > DBBank');
		document.title = addText + stlLib.gbTitle;
	}
};


/**
 * Session 체크 타이머
 *   : 종료시간이 되면 지정된 oCallbackFnc을 호출한다.
 * 
 * @date 2018.04.16
 * @memberOf 장목비
 * @param {String}   타이머ID
 * @param {String}   Callback 함수명
 * @example
 * stlLib.chkSessionTimer( oTimerId );
 */
stlLib.chkSessionTimer = function ( oTimerId )
{
	console.log("=======> SESSION START <=======");
	
	// Timer 초기화
	stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
	
	// Timer 설정(10분)
	$w.setInterval( function(){
		console.log("=======> SESSION END   <=======");
		
		// 지정된 시간이 되면 Timer해제
		stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
		
		// TimeOver시 alert후 초기페이지로 
		stlLib.sessionTimeOver();
		
	} , {delay:parseInt(600000), key:oTimerId} );
};

};

/**
 * 대출금리 안내문구
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 신규금리와 연장금리를 입력 받아 대출조건 상의 대출금리 안내문구로 리턴
 * </pre>
 * @param newInrst : 신규금리
 * @param extnInrst : 연장금리
 */
stlLib.gfnLonInrstWords = function( newInrst, extnInrst )
{	
	var rtnTxt = ""
		rtnTxt += "신규금리 " +  newInrst + "%";

		// (2021.07.21) '99' 입력시 연장시점의 금리로 치환
		if(extnInrst == "99"){
			rtnTxt += " (연장시 변경될 수 있음(혼합금리))";
		}else{
			rtnTxt += ", 연장시금리 " + extnInrst + "%";
		}
		
	return rtnTxt;
};


/**
 * <pre>
 * desc   : 데이터맵을 구성할 Json 배열을 받아 파라미터로 넘어온 JsonObject를
 * 			각각의 dataMap 및 dataList로 각각 담아준다.  
 *
 * 사용예 :
 * 		var arrDs = [ {"dsNm":"ds_nextValue", "dsKey":"nextValue"}
 *				    , {"dsNm":"ds_resMsg", "dsKey":"resMsg", "dsType":"dataMap"}	// 데이터맵 동적생성시
 *				    , {"dsNm":"ds_allLonList", "dsKey":"lonList"} ];
 *	    stlLib.fnSetParam2DS(arrDs);
 * </pre>
 * 
 * @type    function
 * @access  public
 * @param 	arrData			JSON 형태(required)
 * 			------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 			  § dsNm	[필수] : 데이터맵 이름
 * 			  § dsKey	[필수] : 이전화면에서 데이터를 넘길 때 사용한 Key값
 * 			  § dsType  (default - dataMap)	
 * 						 : 해당화면의 dataCollection에 해당 dsNm이 정의가 되어있지 않을 때, 
 *               	  	  'dataMap' or 'dataList'를 지정해주면 동적으로 데이터맵을 생성 후 해당 값을 담는다.
 *          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
 * @return  void
 */
stlLib.fnSetParam2DS = function ( arrData ){
	// 데이터맵 변수 초기화
	var strDsNm, strDsKey, strDsType;	// 데이터맵 이름, Column, Type(dataMap, dataList)
	var arrDsKey = null; 				// 데이터맵 Column 배열
	
	// 이전 페이지 전송 값 가져옴
	var jsObj = common.getParameter();
	if(typeof jsObj === "string"){
		jsObj = JSON.parse(jsObj);
	};
	
	// E2E Parameter가 존재시 전역변수에 저장
	for(var inx in jsObj) {
		if("e2eParam" == stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[inx])){
			stlLib.e2eParam = jsObj[inx]["e2eParam"];
			break;
		}
	}
	
	// DataMap 생성 및 저장
	for(var inx=0 ; inx < arrData.length ; inx++)
	{	
		strDsNm   = arrData[inx].dsNm;
		strDsKey  = arrData[inx].dsKey;
		strDsType = "";
		arrDsKey  = [];
		
		for(var iny=0 ; iny < jsObj.length ; iny++) {
			// Key값이 동일하면 strDsNm에 담긴 데이터맵(리스트)에 해당하는 값에 입력
			if(strDsKey == stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny])) {
				
				// DataObject가 존재하지 않는다면 신규생성
				if( WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === undefined
					|| WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === null )
				{
					strDsType = (arrData[inx].dsType !== undefined) ? arrData[inx].dsType : "dataMap";	// 타입 dafault : 'dataMap'
					arrDsKey  = (strDsType == "dataMap") 
								? stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]])
								: stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]][0])	 		// 데이터맵 Column 배열생성
					common.cfnCreateDataList( strDsNm, strDsType, stlLib.fnGetColInfo(arrDsKey) );		// 데이터셋 생성
				}
				
				eval(strDsNm).setJSON(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]]);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	
};

		for(var iny=0 ; iny < jsObj.length ; iny++) {
			// Key값이 동일하면 strDsNm에 담긴 데이터맵(리스트)에 해당하는 값에 입력
			if(strDsKey == stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny])) {
				
				// DataObject가 존재하지 않는다면 신규생성
				if( WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === undefined
					|| WebSquare.util.getComponentById(strDsNm) === null )
				{
					strDsType = (arrData[inx].dsType !== undefined) ? arrData[inx].dsType : "dataMap";	// 타입 dafault : 'dataMap'
					arrDsKey  = (strDsType == "dataMap") 
								? stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]])
								: stlLib.fnGetObjKey(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]][0])	 		// 데이터맵 Column 배열생성
					common.cfnCreateDataList( strDsNm, strDsType, stlLib.fnGetColInfo(arrDsKey) );		// 데이터셋 생성
				}
				
				eval(strDsNm).setJSON(jsObj[iny][Object.keys(jsObj[iny])[0]]);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	
};

				param = $.extend({}, param, sliceUrlObj);

				param = sliceUrlObj;
			}
		}
		
		common.setParameter(param);
		
		var width 		= options.width;

/**

stlLib.chkSessionTimer = function ( oTimerId )
{
	console.log("=======> SESSION START <=======");
	
	// Timer 초기화
	stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
	
	// Timer 설정(10분)
	$w.setInterval( function(){
		console.log("=======> SESSION END   <=======");
		
		// 지정된 시간이 되면 Timer해제
		stlLib.clearSessionTimer(oTimerId);
		
		// TimeOver시 alert후 초기페이지로 
		stlLib.sessionTimeOver();
		
	} , {delay:parseInt(600000), key:oTimerId} );
};
